title: Asymptotic Growth of Optimal Stabilization Prefactors for the Schrödinger Equations
summary: We study the asymptotic behavior of the optimal stabilization prefactor for the free Schrödinger equation, optimized over all bounded stationary linear feedbacks. For a prescribed decay rate $δ>0$, let $\widehat{C}_S(δ)$ denote this optimal prefactor. Assuming that the uncontrolled region contains a nonempty open set and that the observability cost satisfies $C(T)\le C_0e^{C_0/T}$ for small $T>0$, we prove $$ e^{c\sqrtδ}\le \widehat{C}_S(δ)\le e^{C\sqrtδ}, \qquad δ\gg1. $$ The lower bound is based on the uncontrolled open hole and a quantitative cutoff construction adapted to the Laplacian,…
